test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the give idiom.**

To pay lip service

options.text: To express loyalty, respect, or support for something insincerely
To pretend to be very old
To ignore what someone is saying

solution:
The correct answer is **'To express loyalty, respect, or support for something insincerely'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the idiom** 'To pay lip service' **is **'To express loyalty, respect, or support for something insincerely'.**
 
• **To pay lip service:** express approval of or support for (something) insincerely or without taking any significant action. [ईमानदारी से या कोई महत्वपूर्ण कार्रवाई किए बिना (कुछ) के लिए अनुमोदन या समर्थन व्यक्त करें]
 
 
• *Example: They** pay lip service **to equality but they don't want to do anything about it.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *To express loyalty, respect, or support for something insincerely. *
